captions.detailed: This 3D model is a minimalist, modern, elongated oval vase, often referred to as a 'langloch' shape. It features a flat, rectangular central body with fully rounded, semi-cylindrical ends. The top is open, revealing a hollowed-out interior that follows the outer contour of the vase, while solid cylindrical pillars remain at both rounded ends, creating a unique internal structure.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, elongated oval vase with rounded ends in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to customize the overall length (L), depth (D), height (H), and wall thickness (t) of the vase.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom 'langloch' module to construct the basic rounded-rectangle geometry by unioning a central cube with two cylinders translated to the left and right ends. The main 'vase' module then uses a difference operator to subtract a slightly scaled-down and translated inner 'langloch' shape from the outer one, creating the hollow interior while preserving a solid bottom floor of thickness 't'.
